newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate confirms Cohen as defense chief.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate confirms Cohen as defense chief.

text.p: The U.S. Senate on Wednesday unanimously confirmed former Sen. William Cohen to be secretary of defense, the first Republican in President Clinton's cabinet.
The Senate confirmed Clinton's nomination of Cohen 99-0.

Cohen said at his confirmation hearing earlier in the day that the United States intended to have its peacekeeping troops out of Bosnia in 18 months even if European allies kept a peace mission there longer.
Defense Department spokesman Ken Bacon said Tuesday that Cohen would be sworn in to replace William Perry as secretary of defense quickly after his Senate confirmation.
